seo.description: Building strong roots for a sustainable future. The MAPOU tree is a symbol of strength, deep roots, and resilience in the Caribbean.

sections.heading: Our Values
sections.subheading: Building strong roots for a sustainable future.
sections.body: The MAPOU tree is a symbol of strength, deep roots, and resilience in the Caribbean. It represents the four core values that drive our work at RADIKAL, ensuring our projects are community-owned, sustainable, and impactful.

image.alt: The wide, spreading roots of a mapou tree

items.title: Mityèl
items.subtitle: (mutual aid)
items.body: We organize and empower farmer and artisan networks through collective effort, believing that the greatest solutions are found together.

items.title: Agrikilti
items.subtitle: (agriculture)
items.body: Our commitment to eco-friendly and climate-resilient practices ensures we are not just solving today's problems but are protecting the land for future generations.

items.title: Patisipasyon
items.subtitle: (participation)
items.body: We insist that all project design and implementation be led and owned by the local communities, guaranteeing relevance and long-term success.

items.title: Ouvèti
items.subtitle: (opportunity & ownership)
items.body: We focus on creating viable economic opportunities and ensuring that communities gain full ownership of the resources and benefits generated.
